value.rationale: Provides the full exact integer value for every k of a natural classical binomial-gcd sequence whose prior central result settled only the unit/nonunit dichotomy. Determines all prime exponents and exhibits a concrete minimizing index per nontrivial cofactor, unlocking precise arithmetic classification and replacing an enormous gcd by factorization of k+1; not a mere restatement of the known positivity criterion.
